name: Laser-Cut Profiles & Blanks
summary: Tooling-free profiles and blanks cut from a 1500 × 3000 mm bed — HR steel to 25 mm, stainless to 6 mm.
description: Precision profiles, blanks, gussets and flat components cut on our fibre laser. Because laser cutting needs no dedicated tooling, it is the fastest route from drawing to first part — practical for prototypes, low volumes, and the intermediate batches that fall awkwardly between a hand-cut sample and a die investment. Edge quality comes off the bed clean and square enough that most parts skip a secondary finishing operation entirely. Send a DXF or STEP file and we can usually cut within days.
